title: StatuteRadar Phase 3 adjudicated human annotations
annotator_note: Two independent human annotation packets, with disagreements adjudicated. Fresh held-out diagnostic set; no model predictions were used for adjudication.

obligations.action: provide the data subject information on action taken on a request under Articles 15 to 22
obligations.condition: a request under Articles 15 to 22 is received
obligations.constraint: without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt

obligations.action: extend the response period by up to two further months
obligations.condition: extension is necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of requests
obligations.constraint: by two further months

obligations.action: inform the data subject of the extension and reasons for delay
obligations.condition: the period is extended
obligations.constraint: within one month of receipt of the request, together with reasons for delay

obligations.action: provide the information by electronic means
obligations.condition: the data subject makes the request by electronic means
obligations.constraint: where possible
exceptions: unless otherwise requested by the data subject

qualifiers.text: The response period may be extended by two further months where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of requests.
qualifiers.evidence_quote: That period may be extended by two further months where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of the requests.

qualifiers.text: Electronic delivery is not required if the data subject requests otherwise.
qualifiers.condition: the request is made by electronic means
qualifiers.evidence_quote: unless otherwise requested by the data subject

obligations.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures designed to implement data-protection principles effectively and integrate necessary safeguards into processing
obligations.condition: at the time of determining the means for processing and at the time of processing itself
obligations.constraint: take into account the state of the art, cost of implementation, nature, scope, context and purposes of processing and risks to rights and freedoms; meet the Regulation’s requirements and protect data subjects’ rights

obligations.action: withdraw consent
obligations.constraint: at any time
exceptions: withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal

obligations.action: inform the data subject of the right to withdraw consent
obligations.condition: before consent is given

obligations.action: make withdrawal as easy as giving consent
obligations.constraint: withdrawal must be as easy as giving consent

qualifiers.text: withdrawal is not retroactive: it does not affect lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal
qualifiers.evidence_quote: The withdrawal of consent shall not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal

obligations.action: object to processing of personal data concerning the data subject
obligations.condition: grounds relate to the data subject’s particular situation and processing is based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f), including profiling based on those provisions
obligations.constraint: at any time

obligations.action: no longer process the personal data
obligations.condition: the data subject objects to the processing
exceptions: unless the controller demonstrates compelling legitimate grounds overriding the data subject’s interests, rights and freedoms, or grounds for establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims

qualifiers.text: The right to object applies to processing based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f), including profiling based on those provisions.
qualifiers.condition: the processing is based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f)
qualifiers.evidence_quote: which is based on point (e) or (f) of Article 6(1), including profiling based on those provisions

qualifiers.text: The controller may continue processing if it demonstrates the specified overriding compelling legitimate grounds or grounds for legal claims.
qualifiers.evidence_quote: unless the controller demonstrates compelling legitimate grounds for the processing which override the interests, rights and freedoms of the data subject or for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims

obligations.action: process the personal data of a Data Principal
obligations.condition: the lawful purpose is one for which the Data Principal has given consent or which is a certain legitimate use
obligations.constraint: only in accordance with the provisions of this Act

obligations.action: be responsible for complying with the provisions of the Act and the rules made thereunder in respect of any processing undertaken by it or on its behalf by a Data Processor
obligations.condition: processing undertaken by the Data Fiduciary or on its behalf by a Data Processor
obligations.constraint: irrespective of any agreement to the contrary or failure of a Data Principal to carry out the duties provided under this Act

qualifiers.text: covers processing undertaken by the Data Fiduciary itself or on its behalf by a Data Processor
qualifiers.evidence_quote: in respect of any processing Fiduciary. undertaken by it or on its behalf by a Data Processor

obligations.actor: the Data Fiduciary processing such personal data
obligations.action: ensure the completeness, accuracy and consistency of the personal data
obligations.condition: the personal data is likely to be used to make a decision that affects the Data Principal or disclosed to another Data Fiduciary

obligations.action: present every consent request to the Data Principal in clear and plain language
obligations.condition: a request for consent is made under the Act or rules
obligations.constraint: clear and plain language

obligations.action: give the Data Principal the option to access the request in English or an Eighth Schedule language
obligations.condition: a request for consent is made under the Act or rules
obligations.constraint: access in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution

obligations.action: provide contact details of a Data Protection Officer where applicable, or another person authorised by the Data Fiduciary to respond to communications about exercising the Data Principal’s rights
obligations.condition: a request for consent is made under the Act or rules
obligations.constraint: Data Protection Officer contact details where applicable; otherwise contact details of another person authorised to respond to rights-related communications

qualifiers.text: These requirements apply to every request for consent under the Act or rules.
qualifiers.condition: a request for consent is made under the Act or rules
qualifiers.evidence_quote: Every request for consent under the provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder

obligations.action: present the notice so that it is understandable independently of any other information made available by the Data Fiduciary
obligations.constraint: the notice must be presented and understandable independently of any other information that has been, is or may be made available by the Data Fiduciary

qualifiers.text: The requirement applies to the notice given by the Data Fiduciary to the Data Principal.
qualifiers.evidence_quote: The notice given by the Data Fiduciary to the Data Principal

obligations.actor: A person who fulfils the conditions for registration of Consent Managers set out in Part A of First Schedule
obligations.action: apply to the Board for registration as a Consent Manager
obligations.condition: the person fulfils the registration conditions in Part A of the First Schedule
obligations.constraint: furnish particulars and other information and documents as the Board may publish on its website

obligations.action: intimate each affected Data Principal of the breach and provide (a) its nature, extent and timing, (b) likely relevant consequences, (c) mitigation measures, (d) safety measures the Data Principal may take, and (e) business contact information for queries
obligations.condition: on becoming aware of any personal data breach
obligations.constraint: to the best of its knowledge; in a concise, clear and plain manner; without delay; through her user account or any mode of communication registered by her with the Data Fiduciary

qualifiers.text: The breach intimation duty is owed to each affected Data Principal.
qualifiers.condition: the Data Principal is affected by the personal data breach

obligations.action: adopt appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure that verifiable consent of the parent is obtained
obligations.condition: before processing any personal data of a child

obligations.action: observe due diligence for checking that the individual identifying herself as the parent is an adult who is identifiable
obligations.data_category: identity and age details of the individual identifying herself as the parent
obligations.condition: if required in connection with compliance with any law for the time being in force in India
obligations.constraint: by reference to reliable identity and age details available with the Data Fiduciary, or details voluntarily provided by the individual or through a virtual token mapped to those details and issued by an authorised entity

qualifiers.text: The consent requirement applies before processing personal data of a child.
qualifiers.condition: processing of a child’s personal data
qualifiers.evidence_quote: before the processing of any personal data of a child

obligations.actor: A business that controls the collection of a consumer’s personal information
obligations.action: inform consumers of the categories of personal information to be collected, the purposes for which the categories are collected or used, and whether the information is sold or shared
obligations.constraint: at or before the point of collection

obligations.action: collect additional categories of personal information
exceptions: unless the business provides the consumer with notice consistent with this section

obligations.action: use collected personal information for additional purposes incompatible with the disclosed purpose
obligations.constraint: for additional purposes incompatible with the disclosed purpose
exceptions: unless the business provides the consumer with notice consistent with this section

qualifiers.text: The collection and incompatible-use prohibitions are lifted when notice consistent with this section is provided.
qualifiers.condition: the business provides notice consistent with this section
qualifiers.evidence_quote: without providing the consumer with notice consistent with this section.

obligations.actor: A business that collects personal information about consumers
obligations.action: disclose the consumer’s rights to request the deletion of the consumer’s personal information
obligations.condition: the business collects personal information about consumers
obligations.constraint: pursuant to Section 1798.130

obligations.action: request that a business collecting the consumer’s personal information disclose (1) categories of personal information collected, (2) categories of sources, (3) business or commercial purpose for collecting, selling or sharing, (4) categories of third parties to whom it is disclosed, and (5) specific pieces of personal information collected
obligations.condition: the business collects personal information about the consumer

qualifiers.text: The right is to request disclosure from a business that collects personal information about that consumer.
qualifiers.condition: the business collects personal information about the consumer
qualifiers.evidence_quote: a business that collects personal information about the consumer

obligations.actor: A business that sells or shares consumers’ personal information or uses or discloses consumers’ sensitive personal information for purposes other than those authorized by subdivision (a) of Section 1798.121
obligations.action: provide a clear and conspicuous link on the business’ internet homepages, titled “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information,” to an internet web page that enables a consumer, or a person authorized by the consumer, to opt out of the sale or sharing of the consumer’s personal information
obligations.data_category: consumers’ personal information and sensitive personal information
obligations.condition: the business sells or shares consumers’ personal information or uses or discloses consumers’ sensitive personal information for purposes other than those authorized by subdivision (a) of Section 1798.121
obligations.constraint: in a form reasonably accessible to consumers; the link must be clear and conspicuous on the business’ internet homepages, titled “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information,” and point to an opt-out page
